patch.summary:
Choose ADP Workforce Now only if your buying job matches “Mid-market payroll + HR (Select / Plus / Premium packaging) — custom PEPM quote; no publis” rather than Oracle Cloud HCM's shape. Choose Oracle Cloud HCM only if your buying job matches “Oracle Fusion Cloud HCM — modular enterprise suite (Global HR, payroll, talent, WFM); cust” rather than ADP Workforce Now's shape. Workflow advantage: ADP Workforce Now leans payroll-benefits; Oracle Cloud HCM leans enterprise-hcm. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Positioning: ADP Workforce Now is Mid-market payroll + HR (Select / Plus / Premium packaging) — custom PEPM quote; no published seat $. Landscape vs Gusto.; Oracle Cloud HCM is Oracle Fusion Cloud HCM — modular enterprise suite (Global HR, payroll, talent, WFM); custom quote, no published PEPM..
- Company-size focus: ADP Workforce Now (small-business, mid-market, enterprise) vs Oracle Cloud HCM (enterprise).
- Workflow coverage skew: ADP Workforce Now-leaning payroll-benefits vs Oracle Cloud HCM-leaning enterprise-hcm.
- Researched limits: ADP Workforce Now — No published PEPM — invoices can include garnishment/W-2 extras; Oracle Cloud HCM — No published list price.

Limitations — ADP Workforce Now: No published PEPM — invoices can include garnishment/W-2 extras; Time, talent, and benefits depth live on Plus/Premium or add-ons; Oracle Cloud HCM: No published list price; Oracle Cloud / Fusion stack gravity — not a lightweight SMB HRIS.

Poor-fit cases: ADP Workforce Now is a poor fit when that limitation bites: No published PEPM — invoices can include garnishment/W-2 extras · Oracle Cloud HCM is a poor fit when that limitation bites: No published list price · Avoid ADP Workforce Now if you actually need Oracle Cloud HCM's motion (Oracle Fusion Cloud HCM — modular enterprise suite (Global HR, payroll, talent, )

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
